programme.title: K-CHAT: Travel in Korea
programme.desc: Simple and Fun Korean Lessons, “K-Chat: Travel in Korea” What are the most useful expressions visitors to Korea can use right away?From arriving at the airport to finding your hotel and exploring popular travel destinations, this program offers practical expressions for your Korean language journey. It also covers traditional Korean culture and essential travel information, making it an invaluable resource for beginner to intermediate learners! Discover Korean travel expressions in an engaging and entertaining way with skits performed by ONF’s Hyo-jin, Seung-jun, Wyatt, and Alexa. With clear and accessible explanations from Hye-rim of the Wonder Girls, a graduate of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, you’ll systematically improve your Korean!

programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection. Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers. Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: TALK ROOM
programme.desc: What is the true strength of the K-people leading the K-Wave? We invite the most talked-about figures—those who influence not just Korea but the world—into our studio for intimate one-on-one conversations. Through their stories, the secrets behind overcoming failure and achieving success, and even private small talk, we uncover what makes them extraordinary. When you listen to someone’s story, you enter their world. In this time of dialogue with the most Korean yet most global K-people, we step into the K-Universe.

programme.title: WITH SCIENCE, WE LIVE
programme.desc: Humanity has learned from the past, transcended the present, and dreamed of the future."With Science, We Live"explores the frontiers of science alongside some of the world’s leading thinkers, offering insights into what lies ahead and uncovering new possibilities.In an era of rapid change, where are we headed?As we navigate between the vast universe and the smallness of human existence, we reconsider the direction we must take.Now, in this very moment, we imagine the future shaped by our choices—and move forward toward it.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: The Traitors Ireland
programme.desc: The doors of Slane Castle have opened once again, with 23 new players entering The Traitors Ireland for its second season. The line-up features contestants from across the country, ranging in age from 24 to 61 and including teachers, a postal worker, a psychotherapist, a musician, a stay-at-home dad, an Irish Defence Forces member, and an actor and drama teacher. Hosted once again by Siobhán McSweeney, the players attempt to navigate a game built on trust, strategy and deception, forming alliances while trying to work out who among them they can believe.

programme.title: Weather for the Week Ahead
programme.desc: Detailed weather forecast.

programme.title: Joins BBC News
programme.desc: BBC One joins the BBC's rolling news channel for a night of news.

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: The latest news, sport, business and weather from the BBC's Breakfast team.

programme.title: Morning Live
programme.desc: Join Morning Live for the return of BBC Scam Safe Week, with advice and reporting on the latest scams, and what you need to know to avoid them. With exclusive investigations, new statistics, and live broadcasts from across the UK.

programme.title: Dashcam Justice
programme.desc: A van delivery boss receives an alarming alert: one of his vehicles has crashed, and he can't reach the driver. The footage reveals no sign of braking before impact. An insurer tackles a bitter roundabout dispute involving a parent and baby, while in Liverpool, a driver overtakes a cyclist, then turns straight across their path. The cameras capture the danger and the clues to what went wrong.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Programme in which experts uncover the various tricks of the property auction trade

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: In a special episode to mark BBC Scam Safe week, there’s a case of mistaken identity when Christina Trevanion asks for a cup of tea! Meanwhile, the teams shop for antiques in Derbyshire.

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: A very slick Sky impersonation scammer gives the team a difficult day as he uses multiple types of remote access to control a victim’s phone. With software installed allowing him to run their device, the team try every trick up their sleeve to intercept the scam before the devious criminal can buy himself gift cards.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When burglars target Christine and Gary's shop, taking half-a-million pounds' worth of stock, it’s like something out of a heist movie. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan highlights a worrying new trend called car cannibalism, where thieves strip your car for parts. And we also hear how doggy doorbell detective Truman warns his owners that their high-end luxury car is being pinched from their driveway.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Seaside serenity beckons in Dorset as Sonali Shah helps Norman and Lynda swap city life in London for the calm of the coast. The fantastic line-up of properties includes a mystery house that die-hard fans of the show might just recognise. Sonali also takes a break from house hunting to unwind at a rejuvenating seaweed spa.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero. The boys answer a distress call from Swindon, where a plane-shaped bench paying tribute to the town’s aviation history is no longer fit to fly. A local woodworking group have taken on the task of fixing it, but they’re in need of some assistance from master carpenter Will. Meanwhile, Dom meets Tulsi, who has a Hindu holy scripture passed down from her grandmother that’s now so fragile it can’t be opened without further damage. It will take every trick in the book if paper conservator Angie is to get this beloved tome back to a state where the family can use it once again. One of the great joys of leaving the barn is the chance for our experts to meet some of the passionate makers around the country keeping heritage crafts alive. And few are as passionate as Chris, who is buzzing to teach Will all about the traditional way of making skeps, surprisingly strong, traditional bee hives made out of willow.

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp, assisted by Sarah Greene, hosts the quiz show where contestants race in moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers will stop them in their tracks. Five contestants - Laura, Olu, Jack, Jane, Luke - battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: The brainy quiz returns, but this time Alexander Armstrong is joined by co-host Hugh Dennis. As always, contestants try to score as few points as possible by plumbing the depths of their general knowledge to come up with the answers no-one else could think of.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When the woman who brought Ceaser up in the tattoo world visits the shop for a memorial tattoo from Cease, she has some strong opinions about his relationship with Dutchess. Alex and Dutchess finally meet face to face. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The Black Ink Crew is back! Ceaser & Puma's friendship comes to an end when Puma oversteps his boundaries. Dutchess and Ceaser question whether their relationship is strong enough to withstand the stress of Black Ink's newfound success. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When the electric company arrives and pulls the power because Cease hasn't paid the bill, the crew can't work and they are forced to close the shop. Recording artist Erica Mena stops by the shop to have Dutchess cover a tattoo. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: The sit-down between KP and Lemeir brings about a revelation that catches Ceaser by surprise and leads to new alliances within the Crew. Star and Tim try to ease the minds of team IAM as a deadline is set to recommit to the shop.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: As the day of reckoning dawns, KP, Tim, Star and Cory are surprised by who shows up at the IAM shop willing to work...and who doesn't. Vudu meets with her biological father for the first time since childhood and is unsure she wants to hear the truth.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: After receiving shocking news regarding the legality of their shop, KP and Tim seek help from KP's dad. Lemeir debuts his new food truck venture and shares concern with Barbie about his fractured relationship with Nessie.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: Bad news abounds as KP and Tim find out the shop failed its health inspection, while Nessie and Barbie learn that Lemeir was in a bad accident. Vudu continues to bond with her father by giving him his first tattoo.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: KP and Tim are disappointed to learn that their artists were at Barbie and Danielle's pop-up shop. During a team tattoo lesson with Cory, Nessie explains how she and the other women in the shop were passed over by KP for a potential client.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: Barbie opens up to Dani about relationship issues and pushes Bone to make amends with her father. After suffering a personal loss, Ink is surprised to find out that Vudu and Nessie quit IAM. At the IAM grand opening, Star drops some big news on KP and Tim

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew No Structure to the Madness

programme.title: Black Ink Crew

programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew The Year of the Puma

programme.title: Cheers: Die letzte Zigarette
programme.desc: Rebecca will endlich ihr Leben ändern. Sie setzt ihren Schwur sofort in die Tat um und will sofort das Rauchen aufgeben. Dummerweise setzt sie mit ihrer letzten Zigarette ungewollt das Cheers in Brand.

programme.title: Cheers: Konkurrenz für's Cheers
programme.desc: Nach dem schlimmen Brand im Cheers kann Sam die Bar endlich wieder eröffnen. Er schickt Norm und Cliff los, um Carla zu holen. Die beiden kommen nicht wieder. Seine treuen Freunde haben am Eröffnungsabend seiner Konkurrenz den Vorzug gegeben.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Glückspilsener
programme.desc: Norm hat offenbar seinen Traumjob gefunden: Er soll Bier testen. Dabei schlägt er sich so wacker, dass der Testveranstalter ihm eine Festanstellung in einer Brauerei anbietet.

programme.title: Cheers: Sex für's Vaterland
programme.desc: Sam heuert Henri, den Ex-Freund von Kelly, an. Der beginnt sofort mit seinen Frauengeschichten zu prahlen. Er fordert Sam schließlich zu einem Duell der Herzensbrecher heraus.

programme.title: Cheers: Vaterfreuden
programme.desc: Cliffs Ex-Freundin Maggie ist in der Stadt. Sie will sich offenbar mit ihm treffen. Schon prahlt Cliff mit seinen Liebhaberqualitäten. Diese müssen eindeutig der Grund für Maggies Rückkehr sein. Da erhält er eine schockierende Nachricht.

programme.title: Cheers: Szenen einer Ehe – Teil 1
programme.desc: Lilith hat Frasier vor den Augen Rebeccas betrogen. Da sie ihren Seitensprung selbst gestehen will, verpflichtet sie Rebecca zu absolutem Stillschweigen. Das bereitet Rebecca allerdings große Probleme.

programme.title: Cheers: Szenen einer Ehe – Teil 2
programme.desc: Lilith hat eine Affäre. Sie will Frasier verlassen, um mit ihrem Liebhaber in einen Ökobunker zu ziehen. Alles Bitten und Flehen stimmt sie nicht um. Frasier greift zu einer drastischen Maßnahme: Er will sich vom Dach des Cheers stürzen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Seitensprung
programme.desc: Rebeccas Vater stattet ihr unverhofft einen Besuch ab, um ihren Lebenswandel zu kontrollieren. Nichts von dem, was er sieht, gefällt ihm. Kurzerhand beschließt der strenge Admiral, Rebecca wieder mit zu sich nach Hause zu nehmen.

programme.title: Cheers: Liebe ist...
programme.desc: Carlas Liebhaber Hill erleidet beim romantischen Tête-à-Tête einen Herzinfarkt. Carla kommt nur schwer umhin, endlich ihre Gefühle für Hill einzugestehen. Unterdessen glaubt der neurotische Cliff, dass Adolf Hitler neben ihm eingezogen ist.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Taschengelderhöhung
programme.desc: Rebeccas Vater stattet ihr unverhofft einen Besuch ab, um ihren Lebenswandel zu kontrollieren. Nichts von dem, was er sieht, gefällt ihm. Kurzerhand beschließt der strenge Admiral, Rebecca wieder mit zu sich nach Hause zu nehmen.

programme.title: Cheers: Er kann's nicht lassen
programme.desc: Sam malt sich berechtigte Chancen aus, seine vor Jahren unter großen Schmerzen verkaufte Corvette zurück zu erstehen. Denn die Witwe des Besitzers taucht unvermittelt im Cheers auf.

programme.title: Cheers: Voll reingefallen
programme.desc: Frasier scheint gute Chancen bei seiner jungen Sekretärin Shauna zu haben. Sam ermuntert ihn, ihre Einladung zum Dinner anzunehmen. Aber Frasier hat nicht damit gerechnet, dass das romantische Dinner im Kreis von Shaunas Familie stattfindet.

programme.title: Cheers: Norm in der Falle
programme.desc: Sam ist verzweifelt: Ein altes Spiel seiner Baseballmanschaft wird erneut im Fernsehen übertragen. Ausgerechnet bei diesem Spiel hat er sich unglaublich blamiert.

programme.title: Cheers: Lieber arm, aber glücklich
programme.desc: Unvermittelt steht der Ex-Millionär Robin Colcord im Cheers. Er behauptet, nun bettelarm zu sein. Rebecca glaubt ihm kein Wort. Sie hält das Ganze für einen Test von Robin und versichert, ihn zu lieben, egal wie es um seine Finanzen bestellt sei.

programme.title: Cheers: Hochzeit im Cheers
programme.desc: Carlas Tochter Serafina ist schwanger und will nun heiraten. Sam bietet das Cheers für die Feier an. Carla besteht aber darauf, das Fest im Nobelrestaurant ihres Liebhabers John Hill auszurichten.

programme.title: Cheers: Gefährliche Liebschaften – Teil 1
programme.desc: Lilith will nun endlich die Scheidung von Frasier und teilt ihm dies brieflich mit. Um den am Boden zerstörten Frasier wieder aufzubauen, organisiert Rebecca eine Party für ihn.

programme.title: Cheers: Gefährliche Liebschaften – Teil 2
programme.desc: Lilith hat Frasier und Rebecca in ihrem Ehebett überrascht. Sie will aber dennoch zu Frasier zurück. Doch nicht nur Frasiers Eskapaden verhindern die Wiedervereinigung, sondern auch Dr. Louis Pascal.

programme.title: Cheers: Die letzte Vorstellung
programme.desc: Das Twilite-Autokino soll abgerissen werden. Norm, Cliff und Frasier wollen die letzte Vorstellung, einen Godzilla-Marathon, auf keinen Fall verpassen. Um standesgemäß vorzufahren, leiht Cliff das Cabrio seiner Mutter aus.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg der Kneipen – Teil 7
programme.desc: Sam verliert erneut im Kneipenduell am St. Patrick’s Day. Diesmal muss er einen sehr hohen Preis zahlen: Gemeinsam mit den Männern vom Cheers singt er nackt in Garys Old Town Tavern. Diese Erniedrigung verlangt nach Rache.

programme.title: Cheers: Sam, der Schlafwandler
programme.desc: Sam ist sowohl aus dem Cheers als auch aus seiner Wohnung ausgesperrt. Verzweifelt versucht er, bei seinen Freunden Unterschlupf für die Nacht zu finden. Er landet schließlich bei Cliff und dessen Mutter.

programme.title: Cheers: Cheers im Wahlfieber
programme.desc: Frasier will ein Experiment durchführen. Er möchte beweisen, dass der Wähler als solcher töricht und einfältig ist. Er würde sogar Schimpansen in die Regierung wählen. Also soll Woody für die anstehenden Stadtratswahlen kandidieren.

programme.title: Cheers: Filmrisse
programme.desc: Carla übernimmt den Job des Barkeepers und mixt sogleich ihre berüchtigten Drinks. Tags darauf kann sich niemand mehr an die letzte Nacht erinnern. Carla hatte offenbar eine heiße Affäre mit einem der Männer. Es könnte ja Cliff gewesen sein.

programme.title: Cheers: Mütter – Teil 1
programme.desc: Nach einem heftigen Streit mit seiner Mutter droht Cliff, sie umzubringen. Bei seinem nächsten Besuch im Cheers erzählt er, dass er die Probleme nun ein für alle Mal aus dem Weg geräumt hat. Carla glaubt, dass er seine Drohung wahr gemacht hat.

programme.title: Cheers: Mütter – Teil 2
programme.desc: Rebecca betrinkt sich aus Frust über ihren missglückten Abend in der Küche der Gaines. Sie stört das Hauskonzert und wird des Hauses verwiesen. Die Wachhunde jagen sie durch den Garten. Carla und Norm glauben, dass Cliff seine Mutter ermordet hat.

programme.title: Cheers: Rebecca und Don
programme.desc: Rebecca will ihr Leben ändern. Sie gibt die Suche nach einem heiratsfähigen Millionär endlich auf. Statt dessen verliebt sie sich Hals über Kopf in den aparten jungen Klempner vom Zapfanlagen-Notdienst.

programme.title: Cheers: Dianes Rückkehr – Teil 1
programme.desc: Sams Ex-Freundin Diane hat einen Drehbuchpreis gewonnen. Deshalb ruft sie Sam an. Nach dem üblichen Gerede über die Familie – Sam erfindet kurzerhand eine reizende Frau und vier Kinder – lädt er Diane aus Höflichkiet ein. Sie kommt tatsächlich.

programme.title: Cheers: Dianes Rückkehr – Teil 2
programme.desc: Sams Schwindel mit Rebecca, die er Diane als Ehefrau verkauft hat, fliegt auf. Auch Diane hat nicht ganz die Wahrheit gesagt. Endlich haben Diane und Sam die Gelegenheit zu einer ehrlichen Aussprache. Diese endet prompt in Sams Bett.

programme.desc: Světový bestseller Dana Browna s názvem Šifra mistra Leonarda přichází ve filmové podobě režiséra Rona Howarda. Symbololog Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) je zapleten do záhadné a bizarní vraždy. Po svém boku má vnučku oběti a kryptoložku Sophii Neveuovou (Audrey Tautouová), která společně s Robertem objeví stopy obsažené v Da Vinciho obrazech. Ve snaze rozklíčovat celou pravdu se Robert se Sophií vydají z Paříže do Londýna a cestou potkají nejen spojence, ale i darebáky jako jsou Sir Leigh Teabing (Ian McKellen) a Silas (Paul Bettany). Ať už je kroky zavedou kamkoli, tajemství, které má vyplout na povrch, by mohlo otřást základy křesťanství.

programme.title: Revenant Zmrtvýchvstání
programme.desc: Velkolepý snímek REVENANT Zmrtvýchvstání vzdává hold neobyčejné síle lidského ducha a nabízí strhující divácký zážitek. Legendární lovec a dobrodruh Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) je během výpravy v americké divočině brutálně napaden medvědem a zanechán napospas smrti zbylými členy své lovecké skupiny. V neúnavné snaze přežít a najít vykoupení Glass přetrpí nepředstavitelný smutek, stejně jako zradu od svého souputníka Johna Fitzgeralda (Tom Hardy). Jedinou zbraní mu je nezlomná vůle a láska k rodině, díky níž se Glass pouští do boje s krutou zimou v zatím nezmapované krajině. Tento film, inspirovaný skutečným příběhem, získal tři Oscary: za nejlepší režii, kameru a pro herce v hlavní roli Leonarda DiCapria.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Píše se rok 2061. Zemi sužuje sucho a hladomor, docházejí základní potraviny a planeta čelí prudkým změnám klimatu. Lidské rase hrozí vyhynutí. Tomu by však mohl zabránit záhadný objev v oblasti výzkumu časoprostoru, díky kterému má lidstvo možná šanci na záchranu. Skupina vědců se musí vydat mimo naši sluneční soustavu a pokusit se najít pro lidské pokolení planetu, na které bude moci žít. Posádka lodi Endurance míří do mezigalaktického neznáma, do míst, kam se ještě nikdo před nimi nedostal. Pilota Coopa čeká zásadní rozhodnutí - bude muset volit mezi tím, zda ještě uvidí své děti, nebo se pokusí zachránit budoucnost lidstva.

programme.title: Respect: Královna soulu
programme.desc: Film vypráví výjimečný příběh životní cesty legendární hudební hvězdy Arethy Franklin. Svůj hlas musela prosadit v nesnadných 60. letech minulého století, kdy se Amerika ocitla uprostřed bouřlivého sociálního a politického dění. Výběr herečky, která ji měla ztvárnit ve filmu, schválila ještě samotná pěvecká legenda. Kromě držitelky Oscara Jennifer Hudson (2007, nejlepší herečka ve vedlejší roli "Dreamgirls"), se ve hvězdně obsazeném životopisném snímku představí i držitel Oscara Forest Whitaker (2007, nejlepší herec "Poslední skotský král"), zpěvačka Mary J. Blige či Marlon Wayans.

programme.title: Zatím spolu, zatím živi
programme.desc: V akční komedii je Tom Cruise tajným agentem a Cameron Diaz ženou polapenou mezi ním a těmi, kteří ho - podle jeho tvrzení - do této situace dostali. S tím, jak se jejich divoké dobrodružství mění v bludiště podfuků, úniků na poslední chvíli, falešných identit a opojných romantických, ale naprosto zmatených situací, zjišťují, že jediné, na co se mohou spoléhat, jsou oni dva navzájem. Dvojici hvězdných představitelů doplňují ve vedlejších rolích Paul Dano (Až na krev, Malá Miss Sunshine), Viola Davis (Pochyby) či Peter Sarsgaard (Škola života).

programme.title: Soused
programme.desc: Berlín, čtvrť Prenzlauer Berg. Daniel (Daniel Brühl) je filmová hvězda zvyklá na úspěch. Jeho půdní byt je stylový, stejně jako manželka a chůva, která se stará o děti. Všechno je tip top, a slavnému německo-španělskému herci tedy nic nebrání v tom, aby odletěl na konkurz do Londýna, kde na něj čeká role v americkém filmu o superhrdinech. Když vejde do místního baru na rohu, zjistí, že tam sedí Bruno (Peter Kurth). Záhy vyjde najevo, že Bruno na tento okamžik dlouho čekal. A tak se tento věčně přehlížený muž - jeden z obětí znovusjednocení a gentrifikace bývalého východního Berlína - mstí. Daniel jako jeho cíl...

Rocky se za tréninkem vydává až na mrazivou Sibiř, kde se připravuje na zápas, který se odehraje v samotném srdci Moskvy a bude vysílán po celém světě. programme.title: Takoví normální zabijáci
programme.desc: Režisér Oliver Stone namířil příběh milenecké dvojice amorálních zabijáků, kteří milují vraždění stejně jako jeden druhého, proti soudobé pop-kultuře, fascinované jakýmkoliv projevem zla. Autorem námětu tohoto kriminální dramatu je Quentin Tarantino. Inspirací pro brilantně šokující snímek Takoví normální zabijáci byla divácká obliba reportáží a rozhovorů s masovými vrahy, z nichž se působením televizního média staly slavné a někdy i oblíbené osobnosti. V tomto prostředí paradoxně sláva podněcuje touhu po krvi, bulvární novináři stoupají stále výš a celému národu připadají vraždy zábavné. Zatímco Tarantino ve svých vlastních filmech tyto jevy rád provokativně paroduje, Stone se pokouší o krutě angažovanou a zároveň atraktivní výpověď o iracionalitě násilí v moderním světě.

programme.title: Steve Jobs
programme.desc: Snímek "Steve Jobs" se odehrává na pozadí uvedení tří legendárních produktů na trh a končí v roce 1998, kdy byl představen počítač iMac. Zavádí nás do zákulisí digitální revoluce a vykresluje intimní portrét geniálního muže, který stál v jejím středu. Režisérem filmu je oscarový Danny Boyle a scénář napsal držitel Oscara Aaron Sorkin na základě bestsellerového životopisu zakladatele společnosti Apple od Waltera Isaacsona. Michael Fassbender hraje Steva Jobse, průkopnického zakladatele společnosti Apple, a v hlavní roli Joanny Hoffmanové, bývalé marketingové šéfky společnosti Macintosh, se představuje držitelka Oscara® Kate Winsletová. Spoluzakladatele společnosti Apple Steva Wozniaka hraje Seth Rogen a Jeff Daniels vystupuje jako bývalý generální ředitel Applu John Sculley.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: Caleb Smith (Domhnall Gleeson), šestadvacetiletý programátor největší internetové společnosti na světě, vyhraje soutěž o týdenní pobyt na soukromém horském sídle geniálního a samotářského ředitele společnosti Nathana Batemana (Oscar Isaac). Když však Caleb dorazí na odlehlé místo, zjistí, že se bude muset zúčastnit podivného a fascinujícího experimentu, v němž je nucen komunikovat s první skutečnou umělou inteligencí na světě, umístěnou v těle krásné robotické dívky Avy (Alicia Vikanderová).

programme.desc: S02E05 Protože Ziggy dluží dealerům za drogy, seberou mu jeho milované auto - červené Camaro. Plukovník Rawls ujistí Bunkse, že ho nechce stáhnout z případu, přestože se vražda nedaří vyšetřit. Bodie řeší potyčku v Pitu kvůli nekvalitním drogám. Detektivové předávají přístavním dělníkům předvolání kvůli místní vraždě. Policajtka Beadie Russellová využívá bývalé náklonnosti jednoho z dělníků a pokouší se zjistit, jak se náklad dostal z přístavu. Objeví se požadavek na spojení případu vraždy s vyšetřováním Franka Sobotky a jeho kolegů z odborů.

programme.title: The Wire - Špína Baltimoru
programme.desc: S02E06 McNulty se ve snaze zachránit svoje manželství rozhodne skoncovat s policejními záležitostmi a vzdá identifikaci Jane Doeové. Detektivové najdou v rámci vyšetřování Sobotkova případu v počítači pravidelnost, která by mohla vést k vraždám. Toto spojení se snaží objasnit Danielsovi a navrhují mu, že by bylo vhodné oba případy spojit. Ten však stále odmítá. Sobotka se jménem svého odboru pokouší rozehrát politickou hru. Nick sežene chemikálie, o které ho žádal Vondas, za což si nechá zaplatit penězi i drogami - připravenými k prodeji. D'Angelo se chce vymanit z Barksdaleova vlivu a Bell si k vyřešení tohohle problému povolá pomoc zvenčí.

programme.title: Le zap
programme.desc: Un zapping étonnant qui s'adresse à la génération qui a grandi avec une télécommande à portée de la main. Vidéos amateurs, people, passages télé... Internet fourmille de séquences toutes plus drôles, plus insolites, les unes que les autres. LE ZAP a ainsi déniché les plus belles chutes, des fous-rires mémorables, des performances étonnantes pour surprendre encore et encore. Détente et surprises sont au rendez-vous de ce programme pas comme les autres.

programme.title: Les décaféinés : Les 2 derniers amis du monde
programme.desc: Dans un monde où plus personne ne s'entend, Rémi Deval et Clément Parmentier sont les deux derniers véritables amis, ce qui fait d'eux des parias. Pour redevenir normaux, ils vont faire tout leur possible pour se brouiller. Ecrit en collaboration avec La Bajon et Vincent Leroy, leur spectacle explore les absurdités de l'époque.

programme.title: L'humour en chansons
programme.desc: Qu'ils interprètent leurs propres chansons ou qu'ils s'amusent à parodier des chansons célèbres, les acteurs comiques et les humoristes ont toujours aimé "pousser la chansonnette". Ce documentaire de 90 minutes retrace l'histoire de la chanson humoristique, de l'après-guerre à l'époque actuelle.

programme.title: Les coulisses des interviews de Raphaël Mezrahi Les coulisses des interviews de Raphaël Mezrahi Vol1
Le zap
programme.desc: Un zapping étonnant qui s'adresse à la génération qui a grandi avec une télécommande à portée de la main. Vidéos amateurs, people, passages télé... Internet fourmille de séquences toutes plus drôles, plus insolites, les unes que les autres. LE ZAP a ainsi déniché les plus belles chutes, des fous-rires mémorables, des performances étonnantes pour surprendre encore et encore. Détente et surprises sont au rendez-vous de ce programme pas comme les autres.

programme.title: Swann Périssé - Calme
programme.desc: Swann Périssé, n'a jamais été calme. Elle pensait que la sérénité arriverait avec l'âge, mais arrivée à 30 ans, elle a dû se rendre à l'évidence : elle a un problème avec la colère. Convaincue d'être la seule dans ce cas, elle a commencé à demander autour d'elle comment les autres géraient la leur. Les réponses étaient tellement déroutantes qu'elle a décidé d'en faire un spectacle.

programme.title: Elisabeth Buffet : Mes histoires de coeur
programme.desc: "Et si je vous parlais de mes aventures amoureuses et sexuelles ? Enfin, de mes ratages, sinon c'est pas drôle. Du Cap d'Agde à Pornic, des restaurants dans le noir à la thalasso en passant par des expériences surréalistes, retour sur mes échecs sentimentaux. Pour qu'on en rie !". Elisabeth Buffet, humoriste et actrice, invite à un voyage comique plein d'autodérision et d'observations tranchantes sur la vie moderne.

programme.desc: Capté à Québec dans le cadre du prestigieux festival "Juste pour rire", une sélection de talents émergents issus de l'ensemble de la francophonie offrent un aperçu de la relève humoristique.

programme.title: Les nouveaux visages : Juste pour rire 2ème édition - Saison 2
programme.desc: Capté à Québec dans le cadre du prestigieux festival "Juste pour rire", une sélection de talents émergents issus de l'ensemble de la francophonie offrent un aperçu de la relève humoristique.

programme.title: Kamel le magicien : Crois en tes rêves !
programme.desc: Dans son spectacle familial, Kamel le magicien propose un voyage intimiste où il se raconte et relate son histoire en émerveillant avec de nouveaux tours de magie pour le plus grand plaisir des plus petits comme des plus grands.

programme.title: Le grand show des humoristes
programme.desc: Ce rendez-vous réunit les plus grandes stars francophone de l'humour, et regroupe les moments les plus marquants du Festival Juste pour rire de Montréal. Pour le plus grand plaisir des téléspectateurs, les sketches cultes, parodies hilarantes et duos inédits formés spécialement pour l'occasion s'enchainent à un rythme rapide.

programme.title: Saturday Night Live
programme.desc: La présentation, le monologues et les sketches de Jalen Brunson, Dakota Johnson, Shane Gillis ou encore Inde Navarrette sont les temps forts de cette 52e saison du mythique rendez-vous humoristique "Saturday Night Live", agrémenté de nombreux numéros musicaux, notamment interprétés par Katseye, Turnstile, Rosalie, ou encore Gracie Abrams.

programme.title: Jamel Comedy Club
programme.desc: La 13e saison du Jamel Comedy Club est fidèle aux recettes des précédentes : des humoristes en devenir et déjà très talentueux, un esprit de troupe et un travail collectif, et des numéros de stand-up qui s'enchaînent sans temps morts. Sur la scène du club, les protégés de Jamel Debbouze assurent.

programme.title: Sur place ou à emporter ? - Saison 1
programme.desc: Décidés à réussir, l'un dans la gastronomie, l'autre dans le business, Boriss et Samy ouvrent un kebab dans leur ville. Malgré une débordante envie de bien faire et des idées à n'en plus finir, leur établissement ne rencontre pas le succès escompté. Accompagnés avec sarcasme par PV, client de la première heure, ils jonglent ensemble entre audace et échec.

programme.title: Sur place ou à emporter ? - Saison 1
programme.desc: Décidés à réussir, l'un dans la gastronomie, l'autre dans le business, Boriss et Samy ouvrent un kebab dans leur ville. programme.title: Philippe Bouvard : L'art d'en rire
programme.desc: Avec sa bonhommie et son insolence, Philippe Bouvard a fait rire la France entière pendant plus de 40 ans. Du Théâtre de Bouvard aux Grosses Têtes, de succès d'audience en éclosion de talents, cet homme de média a réussi à imposer son style inimitable dans le PAF. Ce documentaire est l'occasion de revivre ses moments cultes de télévision à travers des archives, des anecdotes inédites et les interviews des protagonistes.

programme.title: Le zap
programme.desc: Un zapping étonnant qui s'adresse à la génération qui a grandi avec une télécommande à portée de la main. Vidéos amateurs, people, passages télé... Internet fourmille de séquences toutes plus drôles, plus insolites, les unes que les autres. LE ZAP a ainsi déniché les plus belles chutes, des fous-rires mémorables, des performances étonnantes pour surprendre encore et encore. Détente et surprises sont au rendez-vous de ce programme pas comme les autres.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los excursionistas cerca de Anchorage, Alaska, descubrieron un cuerpo envuelto en sábanas con bordes de costura naranja.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En algún momento durante una fiesta de Navidad en el vecindario, Melissa Brannen, de cinco años, desapareció. Los investigadores recurrieron a la ciencia forense para ayudarlos a ver lo que se perdieron los testigos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.sub-title: Hasta que La Muerte Nos Separe
programme.desc: Los doctores del hospital no pudieron determinar la causa de las alucinaciones y el intenso dolor de Bobby Curley. Lo trataron como un trastorno neurológico pero su estado se deterioró. Él estaba siendo envenenado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un miembro adinerado de la sociedad muere después de caer de las escaleras, los testimonios de los testigos contradicen la evidencia.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El fuego envuelve la casa donde Lori Keidel y sus hermanos se quedaron solos mientras su padre iba a la lavandería. Años después de la desaparición de su madre, Lori le dice a la policía que fue testigo de la muerte de su madre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El examinador médico clasificó la muerte como un accidente, pero los detectives que investigaron el caso declararon que la evidencia en la escena indicaba lo contrario.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Una pastilla amarga para tragar
programme.desc: Se cuenta la historia de la bombero Michelle Baker. Después de conocer al Dr. Maynard Muntzing, quedó embarazada de él. Después de esta noticia, ella se enfermaba siempre que estaban juntos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un joven bombero murió de lo que parecía ser una enfermedad cardíaca grave pero no diagnosticada, su familia y amigos quedaron devastados, pero no tenían pruebas de algún juego sucio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2004, Rebecca Barney y su futuro exmarido Fred fueron hallados muertos a tiros en su casa de Tulsa, Oklahoma, la cual había sido incendiada.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1998, una actuación de asesinato misterioso en Maryland se convierte en una verdadera novela policíaca cuando se descubre el cuerpo gravemente quemado de Stephen Hricko en su habitación de hotel.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Voto de silencio
programme.desc: Una mirada al caso contra Jack Reeves. Unos amigos informaron que su novia por correo había desaparecido. La policía centró sus sospechas en Reeves y, mientras buscaba pistas, descubrió información que lo vinculaba con la muerte de dos ex esposas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el 2000, cuando la adolescente Tara Munsey desapareció al salir de su trabajo en un restaurante de Virginia, no se sabe si se escapó o si fue víctima de un juego sucio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Se encuentra a Nancy Newman y a sus dos hijas que fueron brutalmente asesinadas. La escena del crimen no tiene escasez de pruebas, pero los investigadores no pueden encontrar un vínculo concluyente con su principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.sub-title: Condena por huella de palma de mano
programme.desc: Una investigación sobre un asesinato se ve favorecida por un requisito legal de que los bares tengan cámaras de video instaladas en las instalaciones. Video, cabello y sangre conducen al asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1996, Gayle Isleib, de 54 años, fue emboscada en su camino de entrada de Manchester, Connecticut, y asesinada a tiros. Ahora la policía debe determinar si el amor se convirtió en obsesión... y en un motivo de asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2003, Tiffany Rowell y tres de sus amigas fueron brutalmente asesinadas en la adinerada área de Clear Lake, Texas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Dientes o Consecuencias
programme.desc: La investigación de un asesinato se ve obstaculizada por la falta de un cuerpo, pero la policía encuentra algunos restos carbonizados, incluyendo un diente cuyo relleno contiene propiedades que ayudan a los investigadores a identificar el cadáver.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Uno para llevar
programme.desc: Una pareja casada decidió escapar del frío del invierno con unas minivacaciones en Key West.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un profesor de gimnasia de secundaria abandona misteriosamente la ciudad sin despedirse de nadie.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un cazador de Colorado que había recibido tres disparos fue víctima de un crimen bien planeado. Los investigadores sospecharon dos armas y dos asesinos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En poco más de un mes, dos mujeres que han vivido en el mismo complejo de apartamentos fueron brutalmente asesinadas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Afición al veneno
programme.desc: Tres muertes aparentemente no relacionadas resultaron ser asesinatos en serie. El asesino había tenido cuidado: usó veneno que no tenía sabor ni olor.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Rompiendo el molde
programme.desc: El hijo de tres años de unos padres de Dripping Springs, Texas, desarrolla una condición respiratoria.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un policía fuera de servicio murió de un disparo, sus colegas oficiales estaban determinados a resolver el crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Fue uno de los crímenes más descarados del siglo 20. Adolph Coors III, el ejecutivo de Coors Brewing Company, fue secuestrado y retenido para un rescate.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: A la mano
programme.desc: Un oficial de policía acusado de matar a su ex esposa insiste en que ella se suicidó. Los investigadores dicen que fue un asesinato, que era físicamente imposible que la mujer se disparara.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women: Greed
programme.desc: Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love to Death
programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Menehune Mischief
programme.desc: When Beth returns to the compound on the Big Island she finds a damaged SUV and two possible culprits - Dog or Justin. Pressed by Beth, Dog offers a third option. The perpetrators are Hawaii's mythical mischief makers - the Menehune!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mister Mom
programme.desc: It's been quite a while since Tim Chapman put down his mace can and bulletproof vest to care for his growing family. When his old friend Dog calls asking for help tracking an elusive felon, Tim jumps into action.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bait & Snitch
programme.desc: With the aid of the runner's girlfriend the posse heads out to bring a client with a checked past in. Little does the team suspect that before the end of the day Dog will be helping to mend a family torn apart by violence.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Scared Straight
programme.desc: Dog tracks a fugitive who is on the run from the law for the first time. Reading the file Dog knows the young man's life is at the crossroads. Will he be able to track down this wanna-be-gangsta in time to convince him to make the right choice?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All My Children
programme.desc: For a guy who started life as a free spirited outlaw-biker Dog has certainly turned into a family man. His children touch everything he does today, from searching for the perfect gift for his daughter Cecily's birthday to hunting a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: The hunt for an elusive and clever criminal takes Dog through the world of a bantam fighting cock, a pregnant daughter, and a jungle safe house go together. And don't forget the mopeds as well as a group of hostile squatters on government land!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bounty Baby
programme.desc: What's a father to do? When the cops ask Dog for help tracking down a renegade teen with a history of running hard, Baby Lyssa, eight months pregnant and counting, insists on joining the hunt. Can Dog keep his daughter safe and catch his man?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rain Check
programme.desc: For Dog and Beth it's not only another day in paradise, it's their anniversary. Beth is hoping for a romantic dinner with her man, but she knows only too well that for Dog work always comes first.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Love on the Run
programme.desc: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date. But he soon learns that she has teamed up with a woman whose criminal exploits have attracted the local media.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Jump Start
programme.desc: Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab. But this commitment to rehabilitation seems to have ended when he bolted from the car on the way to the drug treatment center and went on the run.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Ice Man
programme.desc: Dog's latest fugitive doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of meth when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Trouble in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog is back in Hawaii and tracking a dangerous fugitive through the jungles of the Big Island. Their prey is being protected by a ring of family and friends that Dog must forcefully confront to bring in his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Girl Power
programme.desc: When Dog decides to spend the day caring for his newest granddaughter, Beth enlists the girls to hunt down a female fugitive. Heading into a dangerous part of town the ladies will use their feminine wiles to track this mother gone wrong.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Dog and his old friends, Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck. When Dog learns that the fugitive is also a disrespectful son, he is more motivated to find his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Ties
programme.desc: Dog doesn't have the whole team today and he's got to catch a fugitive with a record of criminal assault. But when Dog finds the fugitive's former girlfriend, she thinks he isn't dangerous at all.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Special Delivery
programme.desc: For months, this fugitive has been stringing Leland along with a series of barely believable excuses. Out of patience, Leland calls in the Big Dog. The whole team heads out to put pressure on the family and friends of the fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surface Scratches
programme.desc: Dog's latest quarry is running from abuse and assault charges. As Dog investigates, he discovers that this fugitive has gamed the system by jumping from one bond, and one bondsman, to another.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Great Debate
programme.desc: When the co-signer of a bond is also romantically involved with the defendant, sometimes the bondman is put in the middle of a lover's quarrel.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Facebooked
programme.desc: Dog is in Denver helping Bobby Brown to track down a fugitive with a long rap sheet. But unfortunately they have no picture of the felon to work with, so the challenges are big on this one. But Dog discovers a new source; "Facebook".

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mano-a-Mano
programme.desc: Back in Colorado, Dog's on the hunt for a runner with more than a decade's worth of trouble with the law. But the fugitive's friends and family are reluctant to help Dog bring him in.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown

programme.desc: After releasing the second part of his autobiography, Dog and his family traveled across America, and this very special episode offers an intimate portrait of both the public and private moments of that journey.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E08 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: Sports Adventure
programme.desc: S06E11 Fish River Ultra (Desert Ultra Marathon). 161 km long, 27 km wide and up to 550 meters deep…the Fish River Canyon in Namibia is the World Wonder you've never heard of - second only to the Grand Canyon in terms of its sheer immensity and often closed to tourists due to the extreme heat, it's nevertheless the playground of the ultra-runner - 100 km through an environment that's as harsh as it is breathtakingly beautiful.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E08 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Paragliding - World Cup
programme.desc: The Paragliding World Cup Superfinal was staged in Roldanillo, Colombia with ten days of high level competition flying in one of the best paragliding venues in the world. One-hundred and twenty-two pilots competed, including 18 previous overall World Cup winners and 12 Women World Cup winners, ranking it as one of the toughest line-ups ever to face each other. Suspended in the air, this adventure sport features cross-country racing, with pilots needing to be an expert in understanding the impact of terrain on weather conditions.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat "HD" Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack "The Black Warrior" Mwekassa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: On the preliminary card, a 4-Man Featherweight Contender Tournament and other one-off bouts were featured.Mirko Cro Cop was first scheduled to face Pat Barry, and later Sergei Kharitonov on this card. However, on May 21, it was announced that Kharitonov had to withdraw from the fight due to injury. He was replaced by Jarrell Miller.Miguel Torres was scheduled to make his GLORY debut as a participant of the Featherweight tournament. However, on May 28, it was revealed he pulled out of the tournament for undisclosed reasons. He was replaced by Marcus Vinicius.

programme.title: iCarly: Alle lieben Shane
programme.desc: Als sich Carly und Sam für den gleichen Jungen interessieren, schwören sie sich, ihn nicht zwischen sie kommen zu lassen. Als sich jedoch beide um seine Aufmerksamkeit bemühen, wird ihre Freundschaft auf eine harte Probe gestellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack Rat
programme.desc: Carly muss eingreifen, als sie bemerkt, dass Spencer eine Videospielsucht entwickelt. Währenddessen versucht Sam Freddie davon zu überzeugen, dass er vom Pech verfolgt sein wird, wenn er eine Ketten-Email nicht weiterleitet.

programme.title: iCarly: Raus aus den Schulden
programme.desc: Sam ist beschämt als Freddie und Carly ihr sagen, wieviel Geld sie ihnen bereits schuldig ist. Sam versucht alles, um es ihnen zurückzuzahlen. Sie überlegt sogar, sich einen richtigen Job zu beschaffen.

programme.title: iCarly: Achtung, böser Stiefvater!
programme.desc: Bei iCarly startet mal wieder die Rubrik 'Jetzt zeigen wir's Lewbert'. Dabei wird Lewbert durch eine Explosion verletzt. Die Kids wollen den Protier wieder gesund pflegen. Doch dann springt Mrs. Benson ein und es kommt zu einer kleinen Romanze.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokosnusscremtorte
programme.desc: Als Carly und Co. Freddie zu ihrem Lieblingskuchenladen bringen, erfahren sie, dass der Besitzer verstorben ist und auch seine Rezepte eventuell für immer verloren sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gut geküsst ist halb gewonnen
programme.desc: Sam bekommt mit, wie Freddie Carly gesteht, niemals ein Mädchen geküsst zu haben und veröffentlicht dieses Geheimnis auf der Webseite.

programme.title: iCarly: Auto oder Aus
programme.desc: Jeffrey, angeblich Sohn von Autohändler Mr. Flanken, will bei iCarly ein Preisausschreiben starten. Der erste Preis, ein neues Auto, soll von seinem Vater gestiftet werden. Nevel gewinnt den Preis, nur stellt sich die Frage, ob es das Auto wirklich gibt.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie gegen Fred
programme.desc: Freddie bekennt ganz offen seinen Unmut über Freds Popularität im Internet, was den sensiblen Fred dazu bringt, seine Videos nicht länger online zu stellen. Doch jetzt sind die Fans unglücklich!

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Colt für alle Fälle
programme.desc: Carly, Sam und Freddie bekommen die Möglichkeit, mit dem bekannten Kampfsportler Jackson Colt ein Interview zu machen. Und zwar backstage während einer Martial-Arts-Veranstaltung.

programme.title: iCarly: Wurzeln, Beeren und Kompost
programme.desc: Mr. Henning fordert im Naturwissenschaftsunterricht Carly und Co. auf, ein umweltfreundliches Projekt zur Grünen Woche zu entwickeln. Carly baut einen illegalen Atomkraft- Generator.

programme.title: iCarly: Amerika singt
programme.desc: Bei 'Amerika singt' steht das Finale an: David Archuleta gegen Wade Collins. iCarly ruft während der Web-Show dazu auf, für David Archuleta zu stimmen. Das Gewissen nagt an Carly und Co., so dass sie ein Musikvideo für den Verlierer machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam ist ein Mädchen
programme.desc: Sam hat Geburtstag und Carly organisiert für sie eine große Feier. Viele sagen ein paar Worte zu Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly lernt einen richtigen Bad Boy kennen. Sie ist von Griffin zuerst gar nicht begeistert, verliebt sich aber schließlich in ihn, was wiederum Spencer überhaupt nicht gefällt. Carly und Griffin versuchen alles, um sich weiter sehen zu können.

programme.title: iCarly: Hier kommt Missy
programme.desc: Als Carlys alte Freundin Missy aus Seattle zurückzieht, glaubt Sam, Missy wolle sie als Carlys beste Freundin verdrängen. Sam riecht zwar den Braten, aber weder Freddie noch Carly wollen ihr glauben. Ob Missys wahre Absichten dennoch entlarvt werden?

programme.title: iCarly: Gib mir iCarly zurück!
programme.desc: Nevel hat sich die iCarly-URL unter den Nagel gerissen und will sie nur zurückgeben, wenn Carly ihn küsst. Unterdessen hat Spencer versehentlich 200 Kissen bestellt, doch Spencer weiß, wie man aus dieser Situation das Beste macht.

programme.title: iCarly: Spind 239
programme.desc: Sam und Freddie haben bei einem schulinternen Wettbewerb gemeinsam den begehrten Spind 239 gewonnen. Doch das Teilen will nicht so recht klappen. Carly bekommt von Spencer Kunstunterricht.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Die iCarly Awards
programme.desc: Carly und Co. verleihen zehn 'iCarly Awards'. Spencer sollte die Statuen basteln, doch der hat versehentlich eine Riesenstatue gebaut. Um auf die Schnelle zehn Gewinne zusammenzuschustern, holt er sich sechs europäische Bademodenmodels zur Hilfe.

programme.title: iCarly: Die doppelte Sam
programme.desc: Freddie versucht zu beweisen, dass Melanie, Sam's Zwillingsschwester, nur ausgedacht ist. Um Sam zu enttarnen, bittet Freddie Melanie um ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 2
programme.desc: Griffin, ein Junge, der ins Haus gezogen ist, 'borgt' sich Spencers Motorrad, um damit eine Spritztour zu machen. Der Diebstahl fliegt auf und anstatt ihn anzuzeigen, nimmt sich Spencer seiner an und bringt ihm etwas Bildhauerei bei.

programme.title: iCarly: Der Schädel von Charles Dingo
programme.desc: Bei der Show 'Totally Teri' tauchen Showsegmente von iCarly auf. Carly und Co. finden heraus, dass die Autoren der Show die Inhalte geklaut haben. Carly, Sam und Freddie überreden Spencer, sie nach Hollywood zu bringen, um diese Sache aufzuklären.

programme.title: iCarly: Der Kuss
programme.desc: Als Sam versehentlich vor Carly enthüllt, dass sie und Freddie sich heimlich geküsst gehaben, konfrontiert Carly die beiden damit, um herauszufinden, wieso sie ihr das niemals erzählt haben. Unterdessen gibt Spencer Kunstunterricht im Gefängnis.

programme.title: iCarly: Voll auf die Kochmütze!
programme.desc: Als Carly und Co. einen bekannten Fernsehkoch in seiner Sendung schlagen, gibt dieser das Kochen auf, bricht seine Show ab und weigert sich, aus dem Schlafzimmer zu kommen. Spencer versucht, seine Vision von der Zukunft Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.

programme.title: iCarly: Der beste Rektor der Welt
programme.desc: Rektor Franklin bittet das iCarly-Team um einen Gefallen: Seine Tochter hat Geburtstag und er möchte ihr live bei der Webshow gratulieren – eine Bitte, die ihm natürlich niemand abschlagen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Date für Carly
programme.desc: Als es zu viele Bewerber gibt, die mit Carly auf eine Party gehen wollen, beschließen Sam und Freddie ein Speed- Dating zu veranstalten. Währenddessen verfolgt Spencer einen bizarren Fitnessplan, angeleitet durch eine Smarthphone- App.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Star von gestern
programme.desc: Das ehemalige Popsternchen Ginger Fox findet heraus, dass Freddie hinter der Produktion des Videos zu Wade Collins Song 'Cry Like a Lion' steckt und setzt alles daran, ihn und die iCarly-Crew als Manager für ein Karriere-Comeback zu gewinnen.

programme.title: iCarly: Carlys Schinken
programme.desc: Carly übersieht beim Überqueren einer Straße ein Auto. Zum Glück gelingt es Freddie, sie beiseite zu schubsen, doch er wird dabei verletzt. Mit gebrochenem Bein und zermanschter Hand liegt er fortan im Bett.

programme.title: iCarly: Schluss mit lustig – Teil 1
programme.desc: Bei iCarly ist ein ziemlich cooles Video eingetrudelt. Die Macher heißen Fleck und Dave und sind obendrein auch noch sehr witzig, weswegen Carly und Sam sie in die Show einladen.

programme.title: iCarly: Schluss mit lustig – Teil 2
programme.desc: Bei iCarly ist ein ziemlich cooles Video eingetrudelt. Die Macher heißen Fleck und Dave und sind obendrein auch noch sehr witzig, weswegen Carly und Sam sie in die Show einladen.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain
programme.desc: In broad daylight on a busy Woolwich street on 22nd May 2013, serving soldier Fusilier Lee Rigby was attacked and murdered by Islamic extremists Michael Adebolajo and Michael Adebowale.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Rhys Hancock was a respected school head; his wife Helen a much-loved PE teacher. When their marriage failed she found love with Martin Griffiths. But Rhys made the choice that ending his wife’s happiness would be worth the long prison sentence.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Raneem Oudeh came to the UK from Syria to escape war, looking forward to a brighter future for herself and her son. Everything was falling into place until she met Janbaz Tarin, a man who saw no boundary between love, obsession, and extreme violence.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Brian and Carla Burns were both medics in their 40s when they met and fell in love. But married bliss didn’t last, and divorce proceedings were messy. Carla disappeared, and fingers pointed at Brian, but he was ready with a bizarre explanation.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Amin Miah wanted a devout, homely wife to start a family with. Mahmuda Khatun wanted a career, a social life - and her family off her back. Their differences were irreconcilable, and one of them would choose the violent way out.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Denise Williams was devastated when her husband Mike disappeared on a hunting trip. He was feared drowned. But Mike’s mother Cheryl didn’t buy it, and after years of relentless campaigning, she finally uncovered the truth about her son’s death.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Lois and David Riess were grandparents and business owners. Lois was also a gambling addict who would do anything to feed her habit. David became the first victim of a murderous rampage that earned Lois the title of America’s most wanted grandmother.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Paul Novak was a thrill-seeking paramedic who loved the hustle and bustle of the city. His wife Catherine was a homemaker and volunteer who preferred small town life. Unable to reconcile their differences, Paul decided to plan the perfect crime.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Lisa and Thomas Infante were childhood sweethearts who grew up on the same street. It seemed inevitable they would end up together. But their marriage was volatile, and when one of them found love elsewhere, the consequences would be fatal.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Raneem Oudeh came to the UK from Syria to escape war, looking forward to a brighter future for herself and her son. Everything was falling into place until she met Janbaz Tarin, a man who saw no boundary between love, obsession, and extreme violence.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: The women in Malcolm Webster’s life seemed prone to bad luck. One died in a car crash. Another suffered a mysterious illness. A third, a keen sailor, found her life jacket punctured. How long before police realised this was more than coincidence?

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Kelly and George Worgan looked like the perfect parents, playing happy families on Facebook with pictures of days out. But behind closed doors, they had financial struggles and rows. When their marriage ended in murder, no one saw it coming.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
programme.desc: Stephen and Anne Searle were the grandparents at the helm of a large, close-knit family. But Stephen was having an affair, and Anne had been pushed to drink by her husband’s controlling behaviour. Neither was destined to enjoy a peaceful retirement.

programme.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
